request.query: Gauss lemma primitive polynomial factors over fraction field lift to base ring

items.name: Polynomial.IsPrimitive.Int.irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_cast
items.type: ∀ {p : Polynomial ℤ}, p.IsPrimitive → (Irreducible p ↔ Irreducible (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) p))

items.name: Polynomial.IsPrimitive.irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_fraction_map
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {K : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
  [IsDomain R] [Nonempty (NormalizedGCDMonoid R)] {p : Polynomial R},
  p.IsPrimitive → (Irreducible p ↔ Irreducible (Polynomial.map (algebraMap R K) p))

items.name: Polynomial.Monic.irreducible_iff_irreducible_map_fraction_map
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {K : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
  [IsIntegrallyClosed R] {p : Polynomial R}, p.Monic → (Irreducible p ↔ Irreducible (Polynomial.map (algebraMap R K) p))

items.name: Polynomial.IsPrimitive.Int.dvd_iff_map_cast_dvd_map_cast
items.type:
∀ (p q : Polynomial ℤ),
  p.IsPrimitive → q.IsPrimitive → (p ∣ q ↔ Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) p ∣ Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) q)

items.name: Polynomial.isIntegrallyClosed_iff'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] {K : Type u_2} [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
  [IsDomain R],
  IsIntegrallyClosed R ↔
    ∀ (p : Polynomial R), p.Monic → (Irreducible p ↔ Irreducible (Polynomial.map (algebraMap R K) p))
